An original young woman with long, straight black
hair and blunt bangs stands in a full-length pose
against a charcoal gray backdrop. She wears a
cropped brown leather vest with covered buttons
over a black ribbed turtleneck, with a matching
brown leather mini skirt and a gold square belt
buckle. Sheer black tights and tall brown
pointed-toe leather boots. Her expression is calm
and direct. Even studio light with soft shadow.
Palette of cognac brown, charcoal, and black.

lookbook.
